examples.en: I'm sorry I left you off the list—it wasn't intentional.
examples.zh: 很抱歉没把你列在名单里—我不是有意的。

examples.en: Women who are the victims of intentional discrimination will be able to get compensation.
examples.zh: 遭受故意歧视的妇女们将能得到赔偿。

examples.en: Changing fashions are nothing more than the intentional creation of waste.
examples.zh: 时尚的变化只不过是故意制造的浪费。
